title: Include dot-prefixed directories
description: Show directories starting with dot (e.g., .github, .vscode, .agent) in the file tree. Currently these are hidden by default.
design:
Current behavior: File tree filters out directories starting with '.' 
Target: Include dot directories in the tree, possibly with a toggle option
Files to modify: src/server/routes/filetree.ts (backend filtering logic), packages/frontend/src/components/LeftPane/FileTree*.tsx (frontend display)
acceptance_criteria:
- Dot directories (.github, .vscode, .agent, etc.) are visible in the file tree
- Optional: Add a settings toggle to show/hide dot directories
- Dot files at root level should also be included
- Maintain alphabetical sorting with dot items

title: Sort files by modified/created time
description: Add ability to sort files in the file tree by modification time or creation time, in addition to alphabetical sorting.
design:
Add sort options to file tree:
- Alphabetical (default, current behavior)
- Modified time (newest first / oldest first)
- Created time (newest first / oldest first)
Backend: Get file stats in filetree.ts
Frontend: Add sort dropdown in FileTreeHeader, store preference in Redux/config
acceptance_criteria:
- Dropdown or button to select sort mode
- Sort applies to both files and directories
- Directories can be sorted separately or together with files
- Sort preference persists across sessions
- Performance: stat calls don't slow down large directories significantly

title: File name wrapping display
description: Enable word wrapping for long file names in the file tree so they don't get truncated or overflow.
design:
Current: Long file names are truncated with ellipsis or overflow
Target: Use CSS word-wrap or text wrapping
Files: packages/frontend/src/components/LeftPane/FileTreeContent/FileTreeItemView.tsx
Consider MUI TreeItem styling or custom CSS
acceptance_criteria:
- Long file names wrap to multiple lines instead of truncating
- Wrapped text remains readable and properly indented
- Tree structure icons remain aligned
- Optional: Tooltip on hover showing full name
- No horizontal scroll needed for long names

title: Auto port number selection
description: Automatically find an available port if the default port (8521) is already in use. Try incrementing ports until one is available.
design:
Current: Fixed port 8521, fails if occupied
Target: Detect port conflicts and auto-increment
Implementation: Add port detection logic in src/cli.ts or src/server/server.ts
Use Node.js net module to test port availability
acceptance_criteria:
- If default port is busy, automatically try next port (8522, 8523, etc.)
- Limit to reasonable range (e.g., 8521-8621)
- Display actual port in console output
- Update browser open URL with actual port
notes:
Implemented auto port selection feature:
- Added findAvailablePort() utility with net module
- Modified serve() to return actual port used
- Updated CLI to use actual port for browser opening
- All tests passing (68/68 backend tests)
- Max 100 port attempts (8521-8621 range)

title: Resizable left pane
description: Allow users to drag and resize the left file tree pane width. Save the preference for future sessions.
design:
Add drag handle between left pane and content area
Use react-resizable or CSS resize property
Store width in localStorage or config API
Files: packages/frontend/src/Layout.tsx, potentially new ResizablePane component
acceptance_criteria:
- User can drag the divider to resize left pane
- Min width: 200px, Max width: 50% of viewport
- Width preference persists across sessions
- Smooth resize without jank
- Mobile: Keep current responsive behavior

title: Full-text search
description: Search across all markdown file contents. Full-text search with results showing matching files and context snippets.
design:
Add search input in header or left pane
Backend: New /api/search endpoint to grep through .md files
Return: List of files with matching lines and context
Frontend: Search results panel/modal with clickable results
Consider: Use existing markdown parsing or simple text search?
acceptance_criteria:
- Search input field visible in UI
- Search across all markdown files in mounted directory
- Show results with filename, line number, and context snippet
- Click result to navigate to that file/location
- Highlight search terms in preview
- Handle large result sets with pagination or scroll
- Exclude dot directories unless included per mdts-4or

title: Tag support
description: Support for tags in markdown files. Details pending from user - may include frontmatter tags, inline tags, or tag-based filtering.
design:
Awaiting user specification on:
1. Tag format: #hashtag, [[tag]], or YAML frontmatter?
2. UI: Tag cloud? Filter by tag? Search tags?
3. Where to display: In file tree? In markdown preview? Separate panel?
4. Backend: Parse frontmatter vs inline tags?
acceptance_criteria: To be defined after user provides detailed requirements
